keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Ignacio Miramón (Gimnasia La Plata).
Delay in match because of an injury Rodrigo Herrera (Newell's Old Boys).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Lucas Janson (Gimnasia La Plata).
Luca Regiardo (Newell's Old Boys) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Goal! Gimnasia La Plata 1, Newell's Old Boys 0. Ignacio Fernández (Gimnasia La Plata) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Lucas Janson following a fast break.
Lucas Janson (Gimnasia La Plata) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Gimnasia La Plata 1, Newell's Old Boys 0.
Goal! Gimnasia La Plata 1, Newell's Old Boys 1. Walter Mazzantti (Newell's Old Boys) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Ignacio Fernández (Gimnasia La Plata) is shown the yellow card.
Martín Ortega (Newell's Old Boys) is shown the yellow card.
